text:
emma_sales: Heads-up: POC with Gateway Inc. — they want to bring Gateway-XL-7B (cust model) for a dedicated trial. Need compatibility check, pricing delta, and security Q answered. Anyone free to triage? cc @jordan_se @nia_mleng

jordan_se: I can take initial compat. Do we have model artifacts or HF link? :thumbsup:

emma_sales: They provided s3 link (private). Also asked about int8 quant variants and 4k context. Quote: "prefers int8 for cost but needs deterministic outputs"

nia_mleng: Int8 + 4k is doable but deterministic outputs may be affected. Need to run a small eval set. Can you grant access to S3 and sample prompt set? :eyes:

sam_platform: Also check KV cache memory layout — some custom tokenizers change KV size. Send tokenizer file.

sam_platform: ```
model: gateway-xl-7b
format: torch
tokenizer: spm.model
quant: int8
max_seq: 4096
notes: "custom tokenizer increases token count"
```

jordan_se: Got the link. Model format: torch .bin + custom spm.model. I ran quick script, tokenization yields longer sequences. Copy of command:

```bash
python tools/tokenize.py --model spm.model --input sample.txt > toks.txt
wc -l toks.txt
```

nia_mleng: Ok that explains increased KV usage. Suggest we provision larger KV quota on Dedicated 1G -> 2G per GPU for this POC, or use prefix-KV caching suggestion. I'll run eval and post perf numbers by EOD. @olivia_revops can you estimate cost delta?

olivia_revops: Estimated delta for Dedicated: +18% baseline for int8 4k with 2G KV. For Hosted API we'd need to offer custom variant pricing +20-25% and legal T&Cs for customer model. Need sign-off on MSA changes for customer-hosted model.

emma_sales: Customer also flagged KMS/HSM requirement and data residency (EU). They want SSO (SAML) and SOC2 logs. @opsec_bot any blockers?

opsec_bot: Security checklist: KMS integration required (Y), HSM optional, SAML OK, EU region supported. Need IP review for model licensing. RUNBOOK: Upload certs to secrets manager; open ticket INFRA-7823 for EU VPC routing.

sam_platform: I'll open the infra ticket and provision a staging pool in eu-west-1 with 2xA10G, 2G KV per GPU. ETA tom morning. Also recommend turning off prefix-cache persistence for deterministic runs.

nia_mleng: Plan: run eval with 200 prompt set, compare int8 vs fp16 outputs (exact-match + instruction-follow), and perf (latency p95). Will attach results here.

emma_sales: Thanks all. Action items: @jordan_se run tokenizer fix, @sam_platform open infra ticket, @olivia_revops draft pricing note + contract delta, @nia_mleng run eval. I'll sync with Gateway tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
